# k8s-lab

> Kubernetes clusters on one Debian or Ubuntu host, managed by Cluster API:
> unprivileged LXC system containers (LXD) as nodes, a self-hosted management
> cluster, workload clusters through Terraform. The repository ships Ansible
> roles, Helm charts, Terraform modules and a Molecule + Vagrant + libvirt
> harness; a deployment keeps its inventory, variables and state in its own
> repository.

## Documentation

- [Architecture](https://k8s-lab.romancello.net/architecture/): the one-host model, the flow from bootstrap to pivot to workload clusters, who owns what, the two-NIC network, the checks, the limitations.
- [Quickstart](https://k8s-lab.romancello.net/quickstart-local/): the whole flow on a local VM with one make target.
- [Deploy](https://k8s-lab.romancello.net/deploy/): a real host from a consumer repository.
- [Variable contract](https://k8s-lab.romancello.net/variable-contract/): every common variable.
- [Runbooks](https://k8s-lab.romancello.net/runbooks/): upgrades, scaling, rotation, reboot, backup and recovery, teardown — each drilled on the harness and says what was not exercised.
- [Troubleshooting](https://k8s-lab.romancello.net/troubleshooting/): failures seen and their fixes.
- [Decisions](https://k8s-lab.romancello.net/decisions/): why it is built this way.
- [Reference](https://k8s-lab.romancello.net/reference/roles/): roles, Terraform modules, charts, versions — generated from the code.
- [Development](https://k8s-lab.romancello.net/development/): layout, conventions, harness, CI, definition of done.

## Bundled

- [llms-full.txt](https://k8s-lab.romancello.net/llms-full.txt): every page in reading order, in one file.
